decision_time_rule: target local date D, cutoff D-1 10:00 America/New_York; only data published at or before cutoff may enter the state card

source_window.split_rule: 2020 local dates TRAIN; 2021 local dates DEV; no FINAL artifact

current_energy_state.total_load_mw.source: ISO-NE hourly system load API raw JSON, Load
current_energy_state.total_load_mw.availability: latest observation at or before decision_cutoff
current_energy_state.total_load_mw.derivation: as-of join, no future value used

current_energy_state.load_factor.source: ISO-NE hourly system load API raw JSON, Load
current_energy_state.load_factor.availability: requires 24 hourly observations ending at or before decision_cutoff

current_energy_state.bus_or_zone_loads_m.source: no verified as-of zonal realized load in the two-year public pack
current_energy_state.bus_or_zone_loads_m.availability: not emitted; forecast zone loads are kept under day_ahead_load_forecast

day_ahead_load_forecast.hourly_load_mw.derivation: sum of eight reliability regions by target hour

renewable_forecast.wind_mw.source: no verified wind forecast joined at the frozen decision cutoff

renewable_forecast.solar_mw.source: available solar observations are historical, not a verified ex-ante solar forecast

own_generator.dispatch_mw.source: ISO-NE public source pack does not identify the focal 9-bus generator

market.day_ahead_lmp_by_zone.source: ISO-NE DAY_AHEAD_HOURLY load-zone LMP CSV has no independently verified publication timestamp in this pack
market.day_ahead_lmp_by_zone.availability: not emitted under the D-1 10:00 ET cutoff
market.day_ahead_lmp_by_zone.derivation: must not substitute target-day DA-LMP for a verified as-of public observation

market.historical_lmp_mean_min_max_sprea.source: ISO-NE real-time hourly load-zone LMP CSV
market.historical_lmp_mean_min_max_sprea.availability: four historical hours strictly before decision_cutoff
market.historical_lmp_mean_min_max_sprea.derivation: mean across zones, then mean/min/max/spread across the four-hour history

network.binding_branch_count.source: published binding-event context, latest observation at or before cutoff
network.binding_branch_count.derivation: binding constraint count; no flow/limit invented

network.max_branch_utilization.source: binding-event source has no verified public flow and limit pair

recent_history.load_last_4h_mw.source: ISO-NE hourly system load API raw JSON
recent_history.load_last_4h_mw.availability: four observations ending at or before cutoff

recent_history.lmp_last_4h.source: ISO-NE real-time hourly load-zone LMP CSV
recent_history.lmp_last_4h.availability: four historical hours ending before cutoff
recent_history.lmp_last_4h.derivation: mean across zones; target-hour future values excluded

future_realized_load.source: used only by audit code to test leakage, never copied into public data

payoff_regret_oracle_action.availability: evaluation or training reward only; never prompt input
